I never went to school, so I farm the way my father did and the way my neighbors do. This plot is small — about three-quarters of an acre — and I grow groundnuts here with some maize scattered between, so I will not buy chemical fertilizer for it because I must save my cash and any coupon from the program for my main maize field. I will haul two cartloads of manure from my cattle pen and spread it before planting, and I will plant seed I kept from last year’s harvest. My wife and children will weed and harvest it with me, and I will not hire anyone because the plot is not big enough to waste money on outside labor.
